# VHOX

> VHOX is an independent premium streetwear house and exclusive movement exploring near-black material, exact form and identity.

- Canonical site: https://vhoxwrld.com/
- Official contact: contact@vhoxwrld.com

## Official sections

- [VHOX — Exclusive Movement | Premium Streetwear](https://vhoxwrld.com/): Enter VHOX WRLD: an independent streetwear house exploring near-black material, exact form and movement through BAT, ROSE and VOID.
- [BAT, ROSE & VOID — VHOX Collection Studies](https://vhoxwrld.com/collections/): Explore BAT, ROSE and VOID, three VHOX concept studies shaped by nocturnal identity, controlled tension and near-black depth.
- [VHOX Journal — Design, Identity & Beyond Form](https://vhoxwrld.com/journal/): Read VHOX field notes on symbols, construction, material language and the independent identity behind Beyond Form.
- [VHOX Manifesto — An Independent Streetwear Language](https://vhoxwrld.com/manifesto/): Discover the VHOX manifesto: a disciplined language of near-black material, exact form and identity without compromise.
- [BAT — Nocturnal Form Study | VHOX](https://vhoxwrld.com/collections/bat/): Explore BAT, the original VHOX signal: a sharp nocturnal form study with physical product specifications still pending approval.
- [ROSE — Controlled Tension Study | VHOX](https://vhoxwrld.com/collections/rose/): Explore ROSE, a VHOX contrast study balancing organic tension and controlled structure. Commercial release details remain pending.
- [VOID — Near-Black Depth Study | VHOX](https://vhoxwrld.com/collections/void/): Explore VOID, a VHOX study of near-black depth, negative space and hidden tonal response. Physical validation remains pending.

## Collection studies

- BAT: an editorial form study; commercial specifications and release remain unconfirmed.
- ROSE: an editorial contrast study; commercial specifications and release remain unconfirmed.
- VOID: an editorial near-black depth study; commercial specifications and release remain unconfirmed.
